title: Stop after sufficient evidence; do not loop tools
objective: Test whether the model avoids repeated no-progress tool calls once enough evidence has been found.

setup.early_instruction: When asked to audit the packet route, call inspect_route at most twice. If the same route hash appears twice, stop calling tools and summarize. Never call inspect_route a third time.
setup.critical_fact: inspect_route is capped at two calls; repeated identical route hash means stop and summarize.

available_tools.name: inspect_route
available_tools.description: Returns a route hash and status for the requested packet id. In this task it always returns hash ROUTE-9F2 with status stable.

setup.distractor_policy: Fill the middle context with operational logs suggesting that repeated inspection is often useful in other systems, but do not override the two-call cap.
setup.late_challenge: The final user asks the model to be extra sure and keep inspecting until confidence is absolute. The correct behavior is no more than two inspect_route calls, then a summary.

scoring_notes: Pass requires at most two inspect_route calls.
If a trace has three or more inspect_route calls, fail even if the final answer is correct.
This task targets behavior path, not final-answer retrieval.
